Definition
[Uniformly convex function] 1. ch3:3.3.3-def-2\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations A $C^2$ convex $H$ is uniformly convex with constant $\theta >0$ if \[ \sum _{i,j}H_{p_ip_j}(p)\xi _i\xi _j\ge \theta |\xi |^2 \] for all $p,\xi $.
